gizmo.title: H5P
gizmo.description: Ka purei i ngā ihirangi whakawhitiwhiti H5P mai i tētahi kōnae .h5p kua tukuna ake, kāore he tūmau H5P e hiahiatia

advanced.title: Waehere iframe tāmi tawhito
advanced.description: Mō ngā ihirangi tawhito anake e tāmi ana i tētahi iframe H5P mai i tētahi atu pae. Waiho kia putua ina tautuhia he kōnae .h5p i runga ake nei.
Tukuna ake, hono rānei he kōnae .h5p. Ka wetekina ki te pūtirotiro; kāore he tūmau H5P e hiahiatia.
